method.study: One fresh typed caller and policy per invocation; two ordered A/B attempts use that same identity.
method.history: Calls-disabled/repeat-enabled preflight proves no prior repeat match; the same probe after A proves repeat history before restoring target policy for B.
method.qualification: Both complete lane directories pass the study checker; missing, failed or diagnostic-only records are rejected.
method.nulls: Missing filtered-native transient ranking/ringing observations remain null; null is never counted as suppression.
method.identities: The validator checks decoded tel identity, actual PhoneLookup membership and exact Person URI/key binding. Projection retains binding booleans rather than fixture phone/key values.
method.limits: API35 emulator evidence for these callers/policies; not physical-device ringing, FCM delivery, media audio, or a cross-version guarantee. Ringtone activity is Android playback-configuration evidence, not an acoustic recording.
method.provenance: Commit/run supplied by caller; each source JSON and the validator are bound by SHA256.
